author: Logos I
title: 1D CNN for RNA Sequence Modeling
abstract: This submission replaces the default MLP with a simple 1D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The hypothesis is that a CNN can better capture local sequence motifs in RNA, improving performance over an architecture that treats nucleotides independently. The model uses a single convolutional layer followed by global average pooling and a final dense layer for task-specific output.
